entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling about an order I received a few weeks ago. I'd like to start a return for a helmet.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference thing. The color just isn't what I expected when I saw it online. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out.
I understand. Getting the right color is important. Let me just pull up our policy for you. Could you provide me with your order number?

Thank you. Let's see... okay, I see the order here. It was delivered 21 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. So, yes, we can absolutely process that return for a full refund.

Okay, that's good to hear. Now, since I have to go through the process of shipping it back and I'm a loyal customer, is there any way you could provide a small discount code for my next purchase to compensate for the trouble?

I appreciate you asking, but our system doesn't allow for discount codes on preference-based returns. However, I can assure you the return process is very straightforward, and we provide the shipping label free of charge. We want to make sure you get the gear that's right for you, as proper fit and comfort are key to safety.
Alright, I thought I'd ask. Free return shipping is fair enough. So, what's the next step?

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Just print the label, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the unopened helmet, we'll process your refund.
Excellent. Thank you for your help, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
